Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We discussed internally and the marketing team is keen to do a short localized case study (1 page) and allow a single-line customer quote plus logo on our website and a short social post. We can provide the quote and assets; attaching our brand guidelines and a short outline of what we'd share.

One ask from procurement: Novatix will only sign off on the pilot price if Redwood provides a one-time 25% onboarding credit (applied to first 3 months) in return for the publicity. Is that something you can accommodate?

Attachments:
- novatix_brand_guidelines.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
- novatix_case_outline.docx (DOCX, 85KB)

Best,

Hi Asha —

Really appreciate the materials and the clear ask. We love the idea of a short pilot story — that should help both teams. I want to confirm a couple of scope items before taking this to finance:

- Scope of publicity: 1-page case blurb, a single-line customer quote (up to ~140 chars), logo usage on website + one LinkedIn post. No broader PR releases without separate sign-off.
- Timing: target publish in Q4 after you approve the final draft.

On the commercial side, Marcus (cc'd) and I discussed a promotional approach: we could offer a one-time onboarding credit, but finance prefers tradeoffs (credit vs. extended commitments). Stephanie from CS, can you confirm whether a 25% credit applied to the first 3 months is feasible from an onboarding budget perspective or if we need to propose an alternate mix (e.g., 15% credit + co-marketing ad credit)?

If teams are aligned on the limited scope above, Marcus and I will escalate to our pricing approver for a formal sign-off.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwood.inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.inference>

Subject: Fwd: localized quote + logo permission for case study  (need executive approval)

Vivek — forwarding Novatix thread. Key facts:
- Novatix (healthcare SaaS) is asking for 25% onboarding credit (applied to first 3 months) in exchange for a tightly scoped one-page case blurb, short quote (140 chars), logo on site, and one LinkedIn post.
- Assets attached by customer (brand guidelines + case outline).
- Region: US; deal id RFQ-2026-094-NVTX; expected ARR at pilot conversion ~ $120k/yr.

Proposal options from commercial team:
1) Approve a capped 20% one-time onboarding credit (first invoice credit) + Redwood-branded co-marketing support (LinkedIn ad credit up to $5k) — lower cash hit, preserves marketing value.
2) Approve full 25% credit but only if Novatix signs a 12-month committed term (otherwise finance objects).

We need your guidance to proceed. If you approve option 1 we can close quickly; option 2 requires executive sign-off and legal to add the publicity limitations we discussed (no press releases, only signed quote and logo).

Context: Procurement pushed hard on price to include marketing permission — this is a negotiation lever they use. We believe the localized case blurb has good campaign value in the healthcare vertical.

On a related note, legal will require a one-time, revocable permission (we keep final sign-off on the quote text).

Thanks —
Marcus
Director, Commercial Operations
marcus@redwood.inference

Team —

Thanks for the context and clear options. I approve option 1 (capped 20% onboarding credit + up to $5k co-marketing ad credit) with these constraints:

- Credit cap must be recorded on the deal record (RFQ-2026-094-NVTX) and applied to first invoice only.
- Marketing permission limited to: single-line quote (max 140 characters), logo on webpage only, one Redwood-owned LinkedIn post; no use in press releases, paid multi-channel campaigns, or third-party materials without separate approval.
- Customer must sign a short publicity consent addendum that preserves Redwood final approval on quote copy and logo treatment. Legal to prepare the addendum and attach to the order.
- Approve only if Novatix executes a 6-month minimum term and commits to a conversion review at 90 days. If they decline the 6-month minimum, reduce the credit to 15%.

Marcus/Kimberly — please document the concession in the deal, attach the Novatix assets to the record, and route the publicity addendum to Novatix for signature. Stephanie — coordinate CS onboarding so the ad credit is tracked and applied.

Once the doc is signed, you can finalize pricing and proceed to close.
